{{Quote|We are a very fortunate people, and we know it. That good fortune should not be taken for granted, and so we try to share and try to help. It is our way of saying that we do not think ourselves entitled to that which we have, but rather, that we feel blessed beyond what we deserve. And so we share, and so we work, and in doing so, we become something larger than ourselves, and more fulfilled than one can become from idly enjoying good fortune!|Ruwee Naberrie|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Ruwee Naberrie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He was the son of [[Winama Naberrie]], the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal Naberrie]], and the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. He was also the maternal grandfather of [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], as well as [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ruwee_Naberrie.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ruwee, at dinner with his family]]
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] in a [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Ruwee Naberrie)|mountain village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="FF90" /> in [[77 BBY]]<ref name="Birth" /> to a cloth weaver<ref name="JournalQuenn Amidala">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref> named [[Winama Naberrie]], Ruwee inherited from his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] a great sense of compassion and empathy that he would eventually pass down to his children.<ref name="DB" />

In [[51 BBY/Legends|51 BBY]], Ruwee [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a young [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal]].<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref> Their respective mothers were very close friends and had secretly plotted to marry off their children. Ironically, the two women were the first to be surprised when Ruwee and Jobal actually fell in love with each other.<ref name="TLotJDoN">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> After getting married, the young couple helped build their [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Padmé Amidala)/Legends|village]] in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Like her husband, Jobal was very generous and compassionate. While Ruwee donated his skills as a builder, Jobal fostered the village's community spirit. His wife eventually became pregnant&mdash;first with [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola]], then four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]].<ref name="FF90" />

Ruwee was also a volunteer worker in the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]]&mdash;having joined the organization at the age of ten&mdash;where his younger daughter Padmé would later follow in his footsteps.<ref name="FF90" /> He eventually became [[President/Legends|President]] of the RRM,<ref name="SWDP" /> and addressed the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] from the box of then-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] about [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] on [[Sev Tok/Legends|Sev Tok]]. He became close personal friends with Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], who agreed with his cause,<ref name="TOEGS1" /> and was his strongest ally in the senate.<ref name="Bombad Jedi" /> In addition to his role in the RRM, Ruwee had been a frequent guest lecturer on microeconomics at [[Theed University/Legends|Theed University]] before becoming a [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]].<ref name="SWDP" />

When his daughters were still young, Padmé received impressive scores to an aptitude test. Ruwee and Jobal therefore decided to leave their beloved mountain village and took their family to live in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], where they hoped there would be more opportunities for Sola and Padmé.<ref name="FF90" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Ruwee and his wife, along with Padmé and their daughter's friend [[Ian Lago]], were busy gathering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies at the RRM's [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] headquarters for the planet's lower-tier dwellers. Ruwee was not really enthusiastic about his daughter's relationship with Ian, as he was the son of [[Kun Lago]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna's]] [[Prime Councilor|Prime Counselor]]. The Naberries also had the surprising visit of Senator Palpatine who had come to try and convince the couple to have Padmé run for the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]. Ruwee and Jobal were hesitant at first, not wanting their just-turned-thirteen-year-old daughter to go through all of this and lose.<ref name="SWDP" />

After being [[Princess of Theed]] for two years, Padmé was elected [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] with a landslide victory.<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|news/13516_1.html|BREAKING NEWS: Amidala Alive / BREAKING NEWS: Amidala Attacked}}</ref> During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]], Ruwee and Jobal were arrested and sent to [[Prison/Legends|jail]].<ref name="JournalQuenn Amidala" /> They were deeply worried about their daughter, who was temporarily forced to leave Naboo. When Padmé stepped down eight years later and subsequently became the Senatorial representative of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], Ruwee stayed in touch with the new [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], in order to get the latest news from Coruscant.<ref name="DB" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], several [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempts]] were made on Padmé.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Ruwee could not help but be afraid for his daughter's safety, but always tried to hide his feelings in order to alleviate his wife's own anxiety.<ref name="FF90" /> In the same period, Ruwee had the occasion to meet his future son-in-law, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="AOTCDS" /> Ruwee immediately noticed Skywalker's deep feelings for Padmé and, as a result, took a liking to the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="FF90" />

[[File:Funeral-Naberries.png|thumb|right|240px|Ruwee and his wife, at Padmé's funeral procession]]
[[19 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], Ruwee, along with his family and thousands of other mourners, attended Padmé's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]], shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had ended.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruwee Naberrie was portrayed by [[Graeme Blundell]] in deleted scenes of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], as well as in a brief scene of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/news20030916.html|text=Casting Update: Two More for III}}</ref>

[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 39|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 39]]'s [[Droids, Aliens & Creatures]] department covers Ruwee Naberrie, but uses his wife's name Jobal instead of Ruwee.
